evaluation.api_contracts: Fresh backend reads confirm exact routes, query names, lowercase sort directions, work/publication/session enums, DTO fields, explicit nullable counts/progress, PageMeta/PagedResult envelope shape, capability boolean and profile whitelist. Serializer omits undefined, empty and ALL sentinel values; size/page are validated by backend. No separate examPublicId is present in the authoritative V1 contract.
evaluation.query_scoping: All reads obtain authenticated tenant/current user, require HOST_ADMIN and target publicId, and include tenant and target in cache keys. Work hooks additionally require consumer enabled. Query object keys isolate dates/status/publication/page/size and future board column requests. No cross-target placeholder reuse. GET query functions forward AbortSignal through existing ApiClient.
evaluation.auth_boundaries: Existing tenant Providers subscribes to protected-session lifecycle, cancels queries and clears the cache. Shared session identity covers actor, tenant and role set; shared client checks session generation before refresh/result acceptance. Workspace reuses this infrastructure. This is static evidence, not live auth-switch proof.
evaluation.dates_state: Approved fixed Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh UTC+7 zone has no DST. Calendar components are parsed and round-trip validated; exclusive to boundary uses next calendar day; invalid/reversed dates preserve previously applied filters and mark invalidDates. Draft changes do not alter applied query until Apply; Apply/Clear reset page. Mounting beneath selected publicId is documented integration responsibility.
evaluation.invalidation: Profile mutation now captures the exact [examStaff, detail, tenantId, publicId] detail key plus protected-session generation in onMutate and cancels only that exact detail query before sending the PATCH. On success it requires the original generation, cancels exact-key refetches, checks generation again after the await, writes the canonical backend account into the captured target key, then invalidates the existing examStaff and tenantUsers prefixes. The captured context prevents a response for target A from writing the currently displayed target B. Shared protected-session changes cancel queries/clear caches and advance generation on actor/tenant/role change. No optimistic profile payload, secret, unrelated phase04 file or new cache boundary is introduced.
evaluation.locale_ownership: English/Vietnamese catalogs share a typed key set, use useLocale translation/interpolation with fallback, and keep copy outside JSX. Presentation, field validation/error rendering and role/tab consumer enabling are deferred to Phases04-06 as explicitly instructed. One LOW missing assertion justification is recorded.
evaluation.integration_boundary: Independent board page states, active-tab/target-role enabled booleans, keyed target filter remount, dirty-edit navigation guard and rendered safe errors must be integrated in Phases04-06. These are explicit handoff obligations rather than missing Phase03 blockers. No claim that route/UI integration already exists.
